applies_to: the next fresh NYC test window (sales dated after 2026-09-30); the published Queens and Staten Island finals are not re-run
decided_from: development-window evidence only: data/backtests/acris_diag_36081_2026-01-01_2026-04-30.json (the 2026-05-01..09-30 test-window run, acris_diag_36081_2026-05-01_2026-09-30.json, showed the same pattern but did not choose the screens)
deed_match: ACRIS Real Property Master (bnx9-e6tj) DEED-type document on the same borough/block/lot (Legals 8h5j-fqxa), document_date within 3 days of the DOF sale date, document_amt within 0.1% of the sale price

exclude_when.why: a share of the property, not the whole home, was conveyed; dev window: 2.3% of sales under $500k vs 0.1-0.2% above

exclude_when.rule: a grantor (party_type 1) and grantee (party_type 2) share a 'LAST, FIRST' surname, ignoring entity names
exclude_when.why: likely family transfer; dev window: 27% of sales under $500k vs 3.3% ($500k-$1M) and 0.6% ($1M-$2M)
court-ordered foreclosure sale; dev window: 10% under $500k vs 4.5% and 1.4%

not_excluded.why: common in every band (dev window 20% / 12% / 6%); estate sales are often at market
common in every band; a trust as party says nothing about price

unmatched_deed: kept (dev window: 1 of 2,186 sales had no matching deed)
